title: MODAVIS VAO Importer for Unity
description: Unity Package Manager plugin for offline validation, selective and transactional import, deterministic execution, linked Playables animation, optional MIDI/XR integration, rights-aware runtime materialization, sampled instruments, and position-aware RIR/SOFA rendering of Virtual Acoustic Object 0.4.0 carriers.

creators.affiliation: Digital Humanities (Image/Object), Friedrich Schiller University Jena; Research Group DIGITAL ORGANOLOGY, Leipzig University
